text: All information regarding builder and architect identities, contractor preferences, specific project assets, and construction methods shall be kept confidential and not disclosed to unauthorized individuals.

All employees must ensure that no personal or sensitive contact information—including phone numbers, email addresses, or any personally identifiable information (PII)—is disclosed in any communication or document to prevent unauthorized exposure.
All internal communications, meetings, plans, and strategic discussions must be kept confidential and must not be disclosed to unauthorized individuals.

All employee information, including identities, roles, schedules, payment details, and internal communications, must be kept confidential and must not be disclosed or shared without proper authorization to prevent exposure of sensitive data.

All sensitive internal information, including communications, strategies, personnel details, financial data, and operational plans, must be strictly protected. Access and disclosure are permitted only to authorized employees on a need-to-know basis. Unauthorized sharing, publishing, or external transmission of any internal information is strictly prohibited to prevent exposure and protect company confidentiality.
All employee-related information, including job titles, employment history, work schedules, roles, and contact details, must be treated as confidential and protected from unauthorized disclosure.

All internal information, including documents, data, processes, personnel details, and strategic plans, must be securely protected and accessible only to authorized personnel. Unauthorized access, sharing, or disclosure of such sensitive internal information is strictly prohibited.

All employees must refrain from sharing or disclosing any personal lifestyle details, work and social plans, vacation or relocation information, personal projects, and achievements in any public or unsecured communication channels to safeguard sensitive information and maintain privacy.
